column1: # DELIBERATELY ABSENT: the 16 openalex works-*-of-10 shards (322.6 GB of .rete,
# 24.4 B triples). Disk is not the blocker -- 32 GB in + ~27 GB out per shard
# fits. The blockers are that ~238 GB of it would have to be downloaded, and
# that 24.4 B quads is not a thing anyone bulk-loads from a bucket prefix: at a
# generous 500k quads/s an Oxigraph load is ~14 hours and a multi-TB store.
# That corpus is what the federated range-read .rete set is FOR:
# openalex-authors (2.735 B) and openalex-entities are exported: together they
# are the identity + venue/institution spine, which is what a "load this into my
# store" user actually wants. Exporting only the 8 shards that happen to be on
# local disk was rejected: a half corpus that looks whole is worse than none.
